0022600023.text: The Lakers (3-1, 1st in the Pacific) come in on a one-game losing streak after their last game, while the Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West) are on a two-game winning streak. Los Angeles leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and it won the 2025-26 series 3-1. The Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Luka Doncic (back), and Ziaire Williams (foot), and the Warriors will be without Gui Santos (knee tendinitis), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery).
